phrases.text_l1: سالي أنا مش عارف شو أعمل
phrases.text_l2: Sally, I don't know what to do
How did this happen to us?
Oh Mom, okay
Okay, I understood
Sanad, Mom says
A delivery is coming with a box

phrases.text_l1: بنحطه بالمطبخ ولا حدا يقرب عليه
phrases.text_l2: We'll put it in the kitchen and no one should go near it
Or touch it
Sanad, here he is, open for him
What is this?

phrases.text_l1: واو بس ما تنسى شو حكت الماما
phrases.text_l2: Wow, but don't forget what Mom said
Sally, Sanad
Wow, it has arrived
Welcome, welcome, it arrived and we didn't touch it
Just as you instructed us
Good, good, kids, because it's a gift
I hope she likes it
What's up? What's wrong with you?
I'm excited, she will definitely like it

phrases.text_l1: أم سند بس بدي أسألك حبيبتي
phrases.text_l2: Um Sanad, I just want to ask you, dear

phrases.text_l1: إنتي انعزمتي إشي عند أم يزن
phrases.text_l2: Were you invited to something at Um Yazan's
A few days ago?

phrases.text_l1: لا بصراحة صارلنا كم يوم ما حكينا
phrases.text_l2: No, honestly, it's been a few days since we spoke
Me and Um Yazan
She didn't invite you? Oh, how shameful
It's normal, it happens

phrases.text_l1: يمكن إشي عائلي وبعدين هي حرة
phrases.text_l2: Maybe it's a family thing, and besides, she's free
No, she's not free and it's not normal
When she invites me and all the neighbors
And doesn't invite you
Really? Well, did you go?

phrases.text_l1: أكيد لا حبيبتي أنا ما بروح بدونك
phrases.text_l2: Of course not, dear, I don't go without you
I apologize to her every time

phrases.text_l1: ليش ولادك نازلين هيك ركض شو في
phrases.text_l2: Why are your kids running down like that? What's going on?
Oh Mom, I have an exam
And I forgot my books at school

phrases.text_l1: وسند جاي يساعدني ما راح نتأخر
phrases.text_l2: And Sanad is coming to help me, we won't be late
Uncle Ata, please
Follow this car quickly
No, brother, what's wrong with you?
Do you think it's a free-for-all?
I don't move from my spot
Without the parents' approval
And agreeing on the price
Do you think it's a free-for-all?

phrases.text_l1: هاد أبوي يا زلمة اشترى سيارة جديدة
phrases.text_l2: This is my father, man, he bought a new car
And out of joy, we forgot and he left

phrases.text_l1: وهو بحاسبك بس اطلع يا زلمة
phrases.text_l2: And he'll pay you, just go, man
But you just look and see with your own eyes

phrases.text_l1: طبعاً ثلاجتها بطلت توسع من كتر الجمعات
phrases.text_l2: Of course, her fridge can't fit anything anymore from all the gatherings

phrases.text_l1: معقول ما قالتلك أنا جايبة ثلاجة جديدة
phrases.text_l2: Is it possible she didn't tell you I'm getting a new fridge?
No, she didn't tell me, believe me

phrases.text_l1: أنا قالتلي بس بصراحة نبهت علي
phrases.text_l2: She told me, but honestly, she warned me
Not to tell anyone

phrases.text_l1: مش عارفة مين هالحد اللي خايفة
phrases.text_l2: I don't know who this "someone" is that she's afraid
Of their evil eye so much
Wow, is it possible?

phrases.text_l1: صدق يا أبو سند بتشتري سيارات
phrases.text_l2: Believe me, Abu Sanad, you buy cars

phrases.text_l1: وعايش حياتك بس مش قادر تسد ديناتك
phrases.text_l2: And living your life, but you can't pay off your debts
Fine, I'm after you, and time is long
I'll show you

phrases.text_l1: ماما لقينا المس وسالي عم تسألها
phrases.text_l2: Mom, we found the teacher and Sally is asking her
A few questions about the exam
I'll talk to you later

phrases.text_l1: بدلي واضرب واطرح ولا وطولان كمان
phrases.text_l2: Change, multiply, and subtract, and he's grown taller too
Man, money works wonders

phrases.text_l1: يا شباب يا إخوان وين رايحين
phrases.text_l2: Hey guys, brothers, where are you going?
You didn't count me in? Fine, I'll show you
Hey guys, where are your tickets?

phrases.text_l1: إحنا جايين مع المدرسة بس سبقناهم
phrases.text_l2: We're coming with the school, but we got ahead of them
Oh, a school trip for 300 students
What? What are you saying? 300 students?
I told them 100 times not to put me
On the shift that has students
They drive me crazy, I'm resigning, goodbye

phrases.text_l1: ألو مرحبا أم سند اشتقنالك كيفك
phrases.text_l2: Hello, hi Um Sanad, we missed you, how are you?
Welcome, Um Yazan
Listen, sorry for bothering you
But I have guests coming and I want to borrow

phrases.text_l1: بكرج القهوة الكبيرة اللي عندك ممكن
phrases.text_l2: The large coffee pot you have, is it possible?
Sorry dear, but it's not clean

phrases.text_l1: بده جلي وتلميع وبعدين أنا كمان
phrases.text_l2: It needs washing and polishing, and besides, I also

phrases.text_l1: بخاف يجي عندي ضيوف ليش ما يجي يعني
phrases.text_l2: Am afraid guests might come to me, why wouldn't they?

phrases.text_l1: أقولك اسألي أم إنصاف ما إنتي على تواصل معها
phrases.text_l2: I'll tell you what, ask Um Insaf, since you're in touch with her
Bye

phrases.text_l1: يي شو مالها أم سند مش على عوايدها
phrases.text_l2: Oh, what's wrong with Um Sanad? She's not her usual self
Hello, we want to bring in a set of antiques

phrases.text_l1: أتوقع إنها هي الشنطة شايفيتها من قبل
phrases.text_l2: I expect this is the bag, I've seen it before

phrases.text_l1: على كل حال تقدروا تدخلوا من هاد الباب
phrases.text_l2: Anyway, you can enter through this door

phrases.text_l1: على اليمين أكيد بتعرفوا غرفة التسليم
phrases.text_l2: On the right, surely you know the delivery room
Of course, of course

phrases.text_l1: شفتوا شفتوا إحنا لازم ندخل على الهليكوبتر
phrases.text_l2: Did you see? Did you see? We have to get into the helicopter

phrases.text_l1: بابا وينكم يا ولاد الماما قلقانة عليكم
phrases.text_l2: Dad, where are you kids? Mom is worried about you

phrases.text_l1: إحنا مرينا نجيب سندويشات فلافل وجايين
phrases.text_l2: We stopped to get falafel sandwiches and we're coming
We won't be late

phrases.text_l1: لقيته لقيته يلا خلينا نطلع من هون بسرعة
phrases.text_l2: I found it, I found it, let's get out of here quickly
Sanad, what did you do?
Don't worry, I'll handle it
See, here they are, they've arrived

phrases.text_l1: مرحبا أم سند حسيتك مش على بعضك
phrases.text_l2: Hello Um Sanad, I felt you weren't yourself

phrases.text_l1: قلت بجيب باقي الحلو وبنشرب قهوة مع بعض
phrases.text_l2: I said I'll bring the rest of the sweets and we'll drink coffee together

phrases.text_l1: أهلا أم يزن إن شاء الله كانت جمعة حلوة
phrases.text_l2: Welcome Um Yazan, I hope it was a nice gathering
Is something wrong? Are you upset with me?

phrases.text_l1: لا أبداً إنتي بتعرفي أنا ما بزعل
phrases.text_l2: No, not at all, you know I don't get upset

phrases.text_l1: بس استغربت إنك بتعملي جمعات كتير
phrases.text_l2: But I was surprised that you're having many gatherings
And inviting Um Insaf and all the neighbors
And not inviting me, and telling them your news
And not me, strange, right?

phrases.text_l1: مين قالك هالحكي جمعات كتير أبداً
phrases.text_l2: Who told you that? Many gatherings? Not at all

phrases.text_l1: هي أول جمعة لزميلة كانت معي من زمان
phrases.text_l2: This is the first gathering for a colleague who was with me a long time ago

phrases.text_l1: وتقاعدت فقلنا بنجتمع وبنرجع أيام زمان
phrases.text_l2: And she retired, so we said we'd meet and bring back the old days

phrases.text_l1: وبعدين أنا ما عزمت أم إنصاف
phrases.text_l2: And besides, I didn't invite Um Insaf

phrases.text_l1: وصارلي فترة طويلة ما حكيت معها
phrases.text_l2: And it's been a long time since I spoke with her
Really?

phrases.text_l1: أم سند منيح اللي لقيتك أنا هسا بدي فلوسي
phrases.text_l2: Um Sanad, it's good I found you, I want my money now
Answer, answer and tell them the truth

phrases.text_l1: بابا الحقنا إحنا بالهليكوبتر ومش عارفين ننزل
phrases.text_l2: Dad, help us, we're in the helicopter and we don't know how to go down
What? How? Where are you?
In the sky, Dad, in the sky

phrases.text_l1: أعطيني أعطيني سند سالي ركزوا معي
phrases.text_l2: Give it to me, give it to me. Sanad, Sally, focus with me

phrases.text_l1: خيو منيح منيح هذه شغلي أول شي
phrases.text_l2: Brother, good, good, this is my job. First of all

phrases.text_l1: في عندك زر فوق لونه أخضر شايفه
phrases.text_l2: There's a green button on top, do you see it?

phrases.text_l1: يمين كبير مكتوب عليه أوتو بايلوت
phrases.text_l2: Big one on the right, it says "Autopilot"

phrases.text_l1: اكبس عليه خيو اكبس وبعدين بتكبس الزر اللي تحت
phrases.text_l2: Press it, brother, press it, and then press the button below

phrases.text_l1: مكتوب عليه أوتو لاندينج خذ مني ما راح
phrases.text_l2: It says "Auto Landing". Take it from me, nothing will
Happen, it'll work, it'll work
I found it, I found it, here it is
Here, we pressed them and it's going down
Thank you, thank you, Ata
Take me, take me to them quickly

phrases.text_l1: طب استنوا شوي طلعت معكم عشان أفهم شو عم بيصير
phrases.text_l2: Well, wait a bit, I came with you to understand what's happening
We were very worried about you

phrases.text_l1: سوري ماما إحنا خفنا تزعلي منا عشان العقد انسرق
phrases.text_l2: Sorry Mom, we were afraid you'd be upset with us because the necklace was stolen

phrases.text_l1: كذبة ورا كذبة لو وصلنا لهون إحنا كتير متأسفين
phrases.text_l2: Lie after lie until we got here, we are very sorry

phrases.text_l1: ما كان لازم نكذب عليكي من البداية أصلاً
phrases.text_l2: We shouldn't have lied to you from the beginning at all
Do you see how important it is to tell the truth?
We apologize a lot, Dad

phrases.text_l1: لو قلتولي من أول كان قلتلكم إنه العقد مش حقيقي
phrases.text_l2: If you had told me from the start, I would have told you the necklace isn't real

phrases.text_l1: ومش غالي وأنا جايبته هدية لصاحبتي
phrases.text_l2: And it's not expensive, and I got it as a gift for my friend
Because she loves these colored stones
And you rarely find any like it
What?

phrases.text_l1: لازم دايماً نحكي الحقيقة الكذب بيوقعنا بمشاكل أكبر
phrases.text_l2: We must always tell the truth; lying gets us into bigger problems
And it becomes hard to get out of them

phrases.text_l1: أنا عرفت مين صاحبتها اللي جابتلها العقد
phrases.text_l2: I found out who her friend is that she got the necklace for

phrases.text_l1: وكمان الكذب بيخلي الناس ما توثق فينا
phrases.text_l2: And also, lying makes people not trust us

phrases.text_l1: وبيخسرنا علاقتنا مع الناس اللي بنحبهم
phrases.text_l2: And makes us lose our relationships with the people we love
Right, Um Insaf?

phrases.text_l1: طيب يا جماعة الحمد لله على السلامة
phrases.text_l2: Okay everyone, thank God for your safety

phrases.text_l1: بس هيك الحساب كتير كبر وبصراحة لازم ننهي المسألة
phrases.text_l2: But the bill has grown quite large, and honestly, we must end this matter
Today before tomorrow
